entries.3306be156e86cdf7: The company recognizes that the mobile game market is entering a mature stage in major regions, and that in the Japanese market the market size available to a new game is shrinking while the development and operating cost per 1 title is on an increasing trend. It positions the growing worldwide popularity of IP such as anime, manga and game characters originating in Japan as a medium- to long-term growth opportunity.
entries.3c377d47e216d25b: It continues to develop titles using leading IP such as manga and anime, and has a track record of long-term operation, including 'BLEACH Brave Souls' reaching its 10th anniversary milestone. It plans to narrow its development genres to action RPGs and sports simulations, its areas of strength, and to use the know-how accumulated through past development and operation.
entries.3cedce916af430b6: This is the group's only reportable segment, which plans, develops and operates mobile online games centered on smartphone apps. Its titles are mainly based on IP from manga and anime, and it operates titles including 'BLEACH Brave Souls' and 'Captain Tsubasa: Dream Team'. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,365 million.
entries.418ce38115a7a193: Based on the description of the business environment in the management policy (market maturity, shrinkage of the Japanese market and rising development and operating costs, and worldwide popularity of Japan-originated IP).
